episodes.title: Chapter One: Welcome to Hawkins, New Kid
episodes.summary: A surprising new threat alters the gang's plans to shovel snow for extra cash, bringing them face to face with danger and closer to a cool new student.

episodes.title: Chapter Two: Bad Harvest
episodes.summary: Nikki joins the party — and the newly formed Hawkins Investigators Club. Strange things take root at a nearby farm and shake up the Winter Festival.

episodes.title: Chapter Three: Evolution
episodes.summary: The kids look for answers about the mutant creatures plaguing their town and get a helpful lesson from Mrs. Baxter, their substitute science teacher.

episodes.title: Chapter Four: The Confession
episodes.summary: A worried Mike decides to come clean to Hopper, and Dustin drags Steve into the H.I.C. Nikki welcomes Will to the mosh pit. Lucas and Max hit the arcade.

episodes.title: Chapter Five: The Weekly Watcher
episodes.summary: When a photo that could put El in danger gets sold to a popular tabloid, the kids pull Nancy into a heist to get it back. If they can't? It's game over.

episodes.title: Chapter Six: A Storm Is Coming
episodes.summary: As a blizzard bears down on Hawkins, Dustin goes on a side quest, and Max and Lucas hear a cry for help. A bold move lands some of the gang in detention.

episodes.title: Chapter Seven: Enter the Storm
episodes.summary: Lucas and Max seek higher ground to call in a Code Red. Across town, Will, Mike and Nikki are snowed in at school — and El can see they're not alone.

episodes.title: Chapter Eight: The Party
episodes.summary: Dustin finds danger at the Food Mart when two terrifying creatures break in. The gang gears up to go underground just in time for Nikki's birthday.

episodes.title: Chapter Nine: The Suspect
episodes.summary: In the wake of a shocking revelation, the H.I.C. digs in to investigate, splitting up into teams to search for more clues and uncover the truth.

episodes.title: Chapter Ten: Countdown
episodes.summary: With time running out, the party pulls together for a brave battle to stay alive. Friends have to help friends — because Hawkins' future depends on it.

episodes.title: Chapter One: A Haunting in Hawkins
episodes.summary: Just when it seems like the Hawkins Investigators Club is completely out of cases, a series of strange new events pulls them into a paranormal mystery.

episodes.title: Chapter Two: The Mine
episodes.summary: After hearing Charlie's ghost story, the guys start filming their video history report in the woods. The girls go into business for Valentine's Day.

episodes.title: Chapter Three: The Curse of Bloodaxe Bill
episodes.summary: Glowing flowers, Hate Sprites and a skeleton inside a spooky mine. Are ghosts real, or is the Upside Down at it again? Time for the H.I.C. to investigate.

episodes.title: Chapter Four: The Séance
episodes.summary: The gang plans a séance to summon the ghost of Bloodaxe Bill. But they'll need Nancy's Ouija board — and step-by-step instructions.

episodes.title: Chapter Five: Split the Party
episodes.summary: Danger scatters the party into smaller groups running for their lives. Mike comes up with a theory to explain what's powering the flowers' eerie glow.

episodes.title: Chapter Six: The Lich
episodes.summary: Our heroes have never seen a creature like this before — and now they're headed straight for its lair. Can El find the Lich before it's too late?

episodes.title: Chapter Seven: The Golem
episodes.summary: A troubling vision reveals the truth about the Lich and where it came from, but it's nearly impossible to believe.

episodes.title: Chapter Eight: Count to Five
episodes.summary: As the Golem tightens its fear grip on Hawkins, it's up to El and her friends to defend their town — and save the people they love.
